title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
coverAlt: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together cover
description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

steps.title: Choose Your Playstyle
steps.description:
Pick the mode that fits you best:

•Single Player — work through the archive at your own pace, quietly and methodically
•Online Co-op — tidy up together with friends, split tasks and share the work
•Online PvP — compete to sort tapes faster and plan the most efficient routes
•Sandbox Mode — every skill is unlocked from the start; experiment freely
•No-Skill Mode — no assists at all; pure manual sorting for the full challenge

steps.title: Learn the Controls & Skills
steps.description:
Pick up tapes, check their labels, and place them on the matching shelf. As you sort, earn points to unlock skills:

•Sort Numerically — auto-orders tapes in your hand by number
•Highlight Shelf — lights up exactly where your top tape belongs
•Highlight Tapes — marks all matching tapes of the same type
•Auto-Placement — sets tapes correctly on the shelf automatically
•Auto-Collect — instantly gathers matching tapes from around the room

steps.title: Know Where Every Tape Belongs
steps.description: Every videotape goes to one dedicated category shelf. Use this list to place items instantly — or rely on the in-game map and shelf signs to guide you.
